<style>:root{--bg:#faf8f3;--card:#fff;--ink:#1d2b2e;--mut:#5d6b6e;--line:#e4dfd3;--teal:#2a7480;--gold:#9a7510;--brick:#8a3a2a;--chip:#eaf2f2;--on:#fff;color-scheme:light dark}
@media (prefers-color-scheme:dark){:root:not([data-theme="light"]){--bg:#10181a;--card:#182326;--ink:#e8efef;--mut:#9fb0b3;--line:#2a3a3d;--teal:#5db7c4;--gold:#e0b83c;--brick:#d98a78;--chip:#1f3034;--on:#10181a}}
:root[data-theme="dark"]{--bg:#10181a;--card:#182326;--ink:#e8efef;--mut:#9fb0b3;--line:#2a3a3d;--teal:#5db7c4;--gold:#e0b83c;--brick:#d98a78;--chip:#1f3034;--on:#10181a}
:root{box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);padding-bottom:env(safe-area-inset-bottom,0px)}
html{scroll-padding-top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:inherit}
body{margin:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--ink);font:16px/1.45 system-ui,-apple-system,"Segoe UI",Roboto,"Helvetica Neue",Arial,sans-serif}
body::before{content:"";position:fixed;inset:0 0 auto;height:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);background:var(--bg);z-index:10}
.wrap{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 14px 40px}
header.top{text-align:center;padding:14px 0 6px}
header.top img{width:min(260px,70%);height:auto}
header.top h1{margin:4px 0 0;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--teal)}
header.top p{margin:2px 0 0;color:var(--mut);font-size:.9rem}
button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer}
.stick{position:sticky;top:env(safe-area-inset-top,0px);z-index:5;background:var(--bg);padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)}
.chip{border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--card);border-radius:999px;padding:7px 14px;min-height:40px}
.chip[aria-pressed="true"],.chip.on{background:var(--teal);color:var(--on);border-color:var(--teal)}
.mut{color:var(--mut)}.small{font-size:.85rem}
.tag{display:inline-block;font-size:.72rem;padding:1px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--chip);color:var(--teal);margin-right:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.tag.g{color:var(--gold)}.tag.b{color:var(--brick)}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--gold);outline-offset:2px}

.views{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:6px;margin-bottom:8px}
.views .chip{border-radius:10px;text-align:center}
input[type=search],select{width:100%;font:inherit;color:var(--ink);background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:10px 12px;min-height:44px}
.fl{display:flex;gap:6px;overflow-x:auto;padding:8px 0 2px;scrollbar-width:none}.fl .chip{flex:none}
.cnt{margin:10px 0 0;font-size:.85rem;color:var(--mut)}
h2{position:sticky;top:calc(env(safe-area-inset-top,0px) + var(--sh,150px));background:var(--bg);margin:14px 0 6px;padding:4px 0;font-size:1rem;color:var(--gold);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;z-index:3}
h3{margin:12px 0 4px;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--teal)}
.c{display:flex;gap:8px;background:var(--card);border:1px solid var(--line);border-left:5px solid var(--k,var(--teal));border-radius:10px;padding:9px 6px 9px 10px;margin:0 0 8px}
.c.soft{background:transparent;border-style:dashed}
.c .b{flex:1;min-width:0}.c .b>b{display:block;overflow-wrap:anywhere}
.c .tm{font-size:.8rem;color:var(--mut)}
.star{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border:0;background:transparent;font-size:1.5rem;color:var(--mut);align-self:center}
.star[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--gold)}
.warn{color:var(--brick);font-size:.85rem;margin-top:3px}
.empty{text-align:center;color:var(--mut);padding:30px 10px}

const DAYS=[["2026-11-03","Martes 3 nov","martes"],["2026-11-04","Miércoles 4 nov","miercoles"],["2026-11-05","Jueves 5 nov","jueves"],["2026-11-06","Viernes 6 nov","viernes"]];
const tm=t=>{if(!t)return"";let[h,m]=t.split(":").map(Number);return(h%12||12)+":"+String(m).padStart(2,"0")+" "+(h<12?"a. m.":"p. m.")};
const nz=s=>(s||"").normalize("NFD").replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,"").toLowerCase();
const EX=q=>/^\d+$/.test(q)&&ALL.some(t=>t.id===q);
const h=(t,c,x)=>{const e=document.createElement(t);if(c)e.className=c;if(x!=null)e.textContent=x;return e};
const SIM=Object.fromEntries(D.sims.map((s,i)=>[s.id,Object.assign({c:"hsl("+(i*53%360)+" 48% 42%)"},s)]));
const ALL=D.talks.map((t,i)=>Object.assign({i,hay:nz([t.t,t.a,t.mod,SIM[t.sim].short,SIM[t.sim].name,t.room,"id "+t.id].join(" "))},t)),T=ALL.filter(t=>t.k!=="Pausa");
const GEN=D.gen.filter(g=>g.k!=="pausa"&&g.k!=="registro").map(g=>{let L=g.x.map(s=>s.replace(/^S\d+_/,"").replace("trabao","trabajo"));while(L[0]&&L[0].endsWith(":")&&L[1])L.splice(0,2,L[0]+" "+L[1]);return{gen:1,d:g.d,s:g.s,e:g.e,k:g.k==="magistral"?"Magistral":"General",t:g.k==="magistral"?(L[2]||L[0]):L[0],a:g.k==="magistral"?L[1]:L.slice(1).join(" · "),room:g.k==="magistral"?L.slice(3).join(" · "):""}});
let st={q:"",day:"",kind:"",sim:"",view:1,fav:new Set()};
try{st.fav=new Set(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("ccm6-fav")||"[]"))}catch(e){}
const save=()=>{try{localStorage.setItem("ccm6-fav",JSON.stringify([...st.fav]))}catch(e){}};
const $=id=>document.getElementById(id),main=$("main");
function chips(box,items,key){box.replaceChildren();items.forEach(([v,l])=>{const b=h("button","chip",l);b.setAttribute("aria-pressed",st[key]===v);b.onclick=()=>{st[key]=v;draw()};box.append(b)})}
$("sim").append(new Option("Todos los simposios",""));D.sims.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.short.localeCompare(b.short)).forEach(s=>$("sim").append(new Option(s.short,s.id)));
$("sim").onchange=e=>{st.sim=e.target.value;draw()};
let tt;$("q").oninput=e=>{clearTimeout(tt);tt=setTimeout(()=>{st.q=nz(e.target.value.trim());draw()},150)};
$("v1").onclick=()=>{st.view=1;draw()};$("v2").onclick=()=>{st.view=2;draw()};
function card(t){
  const c=h("div","c"+(t.gen?" soft":"")),b=h("div","b");c.style.setProperty("--k",t.gen?"var(--gold)":SIM[t.sim].c);
  b.append(h("div","tm",DAYS.find(d=>d[0]===t.d)[1].split(" ")[0]+" · "+tm(t.s)+(t.e?" – "+tm(t.e):"")+(t.room?" · "+t.room:"")),h("b",0,t.t));
  if(t.a)b.append(h("div","small mut",t.a));
  const g=h("div","small");if(t.gen)g.append(h("span","tag g",t.k==="Magistral"?"Conferencia magistral":"General"));else{g.append(h("span","tag",SIM[t.sim].short));if(/^\d+$/.test(t.id))g.append(h("span","tag","ID "+t.id));if(t.k!=="Oral")g.append(h("span","tag"+(t.k==="Póster"?" b":" g"),t.k))}
  b.append(g);
  if(st.view===2){const o=[...st.fav].map(i=>ALL[i]||{}).filter(x=>x.i!==t.i&&x.d===t.d&&x.s<(t.e||t.s)&&(x.e||x.s)>t.s&&x.s!==undefined&&!(x.e===t.s));if(o.length)b.append(h("div","warn","⚠ Se cruza con: "+o.map(x=>x.t.slice(0,48)).join("; ")))}
  c.append(b);
  if(!t.gen){const s=h("button","star",st.fav.has(t.i)?"★":"☆");s.setAttribute("aria-pressed",st.fav.has(t.i));s.setAttribute("aria-label",st.fav.has(t.i)?"Quitar de mi agenda":"Agregar a mi agenda");s.onclick=()=>{st.fav.has(t.i)?st.fav.delete(t.i):st.fav.add(t.i);save();draw(1)};c.append(s)}
  return c}
function draw(keep){
  const y=scrollY;
  $("v1").setAttribute("aria-pressed",st.view===1);$("v2").setAttribute("aria-pressed",st.view===2);$("v2").textContent="Mi agenda ("+st.fav.size+")";
  $("ctl").hidden=st.view===2;
  chips($("days"),[["","Todos los días"]].concat(DAYS.map(d=>[d[0],d[1]])),"day");
  chips($("kinds"),[["","Todas"],["Oral","Orales"],["Póster","Pósteres"],["Magistral","Magistrales"]],"kind");
  let L=st.view===2?T.filter(t=>st.fav.has(t.i)):T.filter(t=>(!st.day||t.d===st.day)&&(!st.kind||t.k===st.kind)&&(!st.sim||t.sim===st.sim)&&(!st.q||(EX(st.q)?t.id===st.q:st.q.split(" ").every(w=>t.hay.includes(w)))));
  if(st.view===1&&!st.q&&!st.sim&&(!st.kind||st.kind==="Magistral"))L=L.concat(GEN.filter(g=>(!st.day||g.d===st.day)&&(!st.kind||g.k===st.kind)));
  L.sort((a,b)=>a.d.localeCompare(b.d)||a.s.localeCompare(b.s)||(a.gen?-1:1));
  $("cnt").textContent=st.view===2?(L.length?"Tu selección, en orden cronológico. Se guarda en este dispositivo.":""):L.length+" resultados";
  main.replaceChildren();
  if(!L.length){main.append(h("div","empty",st.view===2?"Aún no has guardado charlas. Toca ☆ en el programa para armar tu agenda.":"No hay resultados con estos filtros."))}
  let d="";L.forEach(t=>{if(t.d!==d){d=t.d;main.append(h("h2",0,DAYS.find(x=>x[0]===d)[1]))}main.append(card(t))});
  document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--sh",$("st").offsetHeight+"px");
  if(keep)scrollTo(0,y)}
draw();addEventListener("resize",()=>document.documentElement.style.setProperty("--sh",$("st").offsetHeight+"px"));
</script></body></html>
